reason: B is more focused, physically grounded, and falsifiable: it links edge-dislocation super-jogging in single-phase refractory BCC HEAs to a measurable high-temperature strength plateau and proposes correlated mechanical and dislocation measurements. A improperly generalizes edge-dislocation dominance across FCC and BCC HEAs and conflates it with grain-size strengthening and inverse Hall–Petch softening, neither of which is supported by the cited evidence or cleanly tests the proposed edge-dislocation mechanism.
